options.label: chore
options.description: Changes to dependencies, general settings, requirements etc.; no production code change

options.label: fix
options.description: A bug fix. Add SHA if the commit relates to a specific commit

options.label: refactor
options.description: A code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature. Changes that do not affect the meaning of the code (white-space, formatting, missing semi-colons, etc)

options.label: test
options.description: Adding missing tests or correcting existing tests

options.label: model
options.description: Adding or modifying a specific model. Replace "model" with the name of the model

options.label: param
options.description: Modification of hyperparameters. Add model name to typ if the change is specific to a model, e.g., "param(model): change learning rate"

options.label: eval
options.description: Changes to the evaluation or statistical descriptions

tokens.label: Scope
tokens.name: scope
tokens.description: A scope may be provided to a commit’s type, to provide additional contextual information and is contained within parenthesis, e.g., "feat(parser): add ability to parse arrays".

tokens.label: Short description
tokens.name: description
tokens.description: Short description in the subject line.
